title: fix(plugin-email,service-settings): a sender with no From name goes out under the product name

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：发件人名没设置时，邮件不再署名 ObjectStack，而是用产品名（Setup → 品牌 里设的产品名，没设就用部署名，再没有才是 ObjectStack）；Setup → 邮件 的“发件人名称”去掉了默认值 ObjectStack。
- 为什么改：管理员只填了发件地址，收件人看到发件人是 ObjectStack，而主题和正文写的是产品名，显得像别家发的信（卡 #30212 第 3 行）。
- 风险与回滚：只影响“没设发件人名”的默认发件人；设过名字的照旧优先，调用方自带的发件人不改。回滚即 revert 本 PR。以前保存过的“ObjectStack”会被当作管理员显式设的名字继续生效，清空该栏即跟随产品名。
- 先看：packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-plugin.ts（namedSender / applyDefaultSender 与 branding 绑定）、packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/mail.manifest.ts、packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-plugin.mail-settings.test.ts 末尾新 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email exec vitest run src/email-plugin.mail-settings.test.ts`，预期 34 条全过，其中“sender display name follows the product name”一组 10 条。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。第 2 行（导入账号设密码链接 60 分钟）按席位裁定不在本 PR，留在卡上待决。

Part of #30212

Skills-docs: none — `git grep -n -i -E "from_name|mail\.from|from name|sender name|defaultFrom|resetPasswordTokenExpiresIn|set-password link|60 minutes" -- skills` names no sentence about the mail sender or the link lifetime (its one hit is `defaultFromRow` in `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, an action-param key).

Row 3 of the card. Row 2 (the bulk-import set-password link lifetime) is not in this PR: the seat ruled it out after the measurement (a credential-setting link's lifetime, the security seat vacant), so the card stays open for it. Rows 1 and 4 landed earlier.

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/plugin-email`.** `EmailServicePlugin` names a default sender that has no display name of its own with the product name the auth mails' subject and body already read: the Setup → Branding product name (`branding.workspace_name`) when an administrator SET one, else the deployment's name (`defaultTemplateContext.appName`, which `os serve` resolves from `OS_APP_NAME` and the config chain), else `ObjectStack`. This is the chain plugin-auth binds to the auth mails' `{{appName}}`.
  - The Branding value is read on `kernel:ready` and again on every Branding save, so a rename reaches the next mail with no restart. A manifest default is not taken for a set value. The namespace is bound only where the settings service lists it; a walled posture withholds it, and the deployment's name applies there.
  - Which senders: the Setup → Mail sender saved with the From name empty, and a boot sender declared without a name (`OS_EMAIL_FROM` holding an address alone, or `config.email.defaultFrom` with `address` alone).
  - A From name somebody set always wins: a Mail settings From name whose source is not `default`, or a boot-declared name. A sender a send passes as `input.from`, and a template's own sender, are never renamed.
  - "Send test email" sends under the same name real mail goes out with.
  - The plugin keeps the declared sender apart from the live one, so a later Branding save renames only a sender that has no name. `EmailService`'s public surface is unchanged: the plugin installs the named sender through the existing `setDefaultFrom`.
- **`@objectstack/service-settings`.** `mail.from_name` drops its `default: 'ObjectStack'`: an unsaved field reads empty, and the resolver answers `value: null`, `source: 'default'`, as Branding's product name already does. The field gains help text in en, zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES saying that an empty value uses the product name. The Branding manifest's header names plugin-email as a reader of `workspace_name`.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-plugin.mail-settings.test.ts`, new top-level describe "sender display name follows the product name when none is set" in the existing harness (the harness's fake settings service now lists namespaces and serves a `branding` snapshot): Branding name set; Branding unset falls back to the deployment name; nothing configured gives `ObjectStack`; an explicit From name wins; a From name that is only a manifest default does not; a Branding save and a Branding clear take effect without a restart; a boot sender without a name is named; a caller's own `from` is untouched; no Branding read under a walled posture; the test mail carries the name.
- `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/mail.manifest.test.ts`: `from_name` declares no default, stays optional, and carries the help text.

## Acceptance notes

- A From name stored before this change (for example `ObjectStack`, if a save sent the prefilled default) is an explicit value and keeps winning. Clearing the field makes the sender follow the product name.
- The boot fallback sender that `resolveEmailCapabilityArg` builds when nothing declares one keeps its derived name (the deployment's name). Setup → Branding does not rename that one. It is the sender for a deployment with no From address configured anywhere.
- Non-auth templates render `{{appName}}` from the boot-time template context (the deployment's name), not from Setup → Branding. This PR does not change that. Only the auth mails read the Branding product name today.
